scripts.setup: pnpm install && cd workers && uv sync && cd .. && pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,worker -c magenta,cyan "pnpm --dir apps/web dev" "cd workers && uv run worker"
